scope: Paragraph alignment, margins, indentation, list levels, spacing, bullets, numbering, direction and tabs. Historical inventories remain unchanged.
verification: Final audit suite: 69 paragraph cases and 26 alignment cases passed (95 total, 37 ms summed test time). Exact expanded row targets below; Paragraph direct properties retain Length semantics.

language_security_mappings.J01: Neutral paragraph model spellings remain authoritative; operation keys are camelCase.
language_security_mappings.J02: Local snapshot absence is null; inherited style resolution remains separate. No ambient host access.
language_security_mappings.J04: Stable numeric enum symbols and alias; from_xml/to_xml/validate retained. Numeric primitives cannot expose instance metadata, so metadata(value) returns a frozen {name,value,xml_value} record. MIXED metadata has xml_value:null and conversion/assignment rejects it. Enum object and helper properties are frozen and typed readonly.
language_security_mappings.J05: Model Length helpers store safe integer EMUs; before/after are Length|null and line_spacing is Length|number|null. Operation values use points/tagged spacing. Explicit zero retains local value; omitted retains; null clears.
language_security_mappings.J08: Numeric line multiples do not expose .pt in JS; null dereference is native TypeError. No wrapper reproduces Python primitive attribute errors.
language_security_mappings.J10: Formatting preserves mixed runs, breaks and fields. No wrapping is calculated.
